target.summary: When a write parks due to backpressure, writeContinuation executes without capturing and restoring the writer's async context. Consequently, when backpressure is relieved by a read, transform() and subsequent write steps run in the reader's AsyncLocalStorage context instead of the writer's.
notes: faulty writeContinuation executes without capturing and restoring the writer's async context
